premises.text: People prefer image-based communication but logos currently do little useful work inside mobile messaging
premises.evidence_span: what can you actually do with logos on mobile, and particularly on messaging? The answer is not much

premises.text: Logi packages deep-linked aggregated brand and place data inside logos in iMessage
premises.evidence_span: packaged inside of those logos you know and love

premises.text: Anyone can add logos worldwide; brands reclaim and edit profiles; Google fills gaps on the go
premises.evidence_span: Via our integration with Google, you can create an instant logo profile on the go

premises.text: Brands monetize via sponsored placement, customizations, integrations, and analytics on the logo platform
premises.evidence_span: This is an entirely new mobile marketing platform

value.text: Smarter search and share of useful information via interactive logos in messaging
value.evidence_span: bring interactive logos to mobile messaging as a smarter way to search and share information

secondary_value.text: Give brands useful information delivery consumers want
secondary_value.evidence_span: brands are still having trouble providing consumers with what they actually want, useful information

causal_links.evidence_span: Logi is here to change that
most useful and actionable information in one place
sponsor it for premium placement, do branded content and customizations

notes: People/social profile sharing treated as application of same logo mechanism, not a separate premise. Download CTA excluded.
